correctness.rationale: The minimal-forbidden condition for w=a v b is exactly that av and vb belong to the one-step image language while avb does not. Four-state de Bruijn subset transitions encode this language exactly; the pair-of-subsets automata recognize each first offender uniquely. Trimming unreachable and non-coreachable states, Tarjan SCC analysis gives exhaustive finite/bounded/polynomial/exponential alternatives for accepted path counts. The exact 256-rule case enumeration yields 176/28/0/52; longest paths prove length-ten finite cutoff exactly at 57/99/156/198. Integer transfer-vector exact repetition proves all four bounded all-length formulas and m(n)<=2. The saved `verify.py` with `classification.csv` also directly enumerates the 256 x 9 independent input-block image languages at lengths 1..9. No finite sample is used to prove an infinite classification.

value.rationale: Minimal forbidden word growth is a classical symbolic-dynamical conjugacy invariant; its exact classes measure the complexity of local obstructions in one-step images. The 52 exponentially proliferating systems and 28 systems with uniformly at most two obstructions per length are mathematically distinct even though both can be strictly sofic. The absence of an intermediate polynomial regime is an exact structural phenomenon of this canonical finite family, and the four bounded signatures furnish explicit all-length classifications. This is neither a free normalization consequence nor a single arbitrary short-length census.
